info.title: subkit engine
info.description: Backend workflow engine. See /docs for the interactive reference and /openapi.json for the raw spec. LLM clients can ground themselves on /llms.txt (index) or /llms-full.txt (full docs in one fetch), per https://llmstxt.org.

bearerAuth.description: SubKit API key or an OAuth 2.1 access token issued by the MCP authorization server.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE. Browser login uses product-local API-key or direct OIDC adapters.

scopes.mcp:read: Read published content, resources, and product statistics

plaintext_token.description: Only returned once at issue time. Hand to the invited user; the engine never shows it again.

api_key.description: The invited user's personal API key. Returned exactly once.

plaintext_key.description: Only returned once at issue time. Store securely.

authorization_url.description: URL the operator's browser must open to grant access.

state.description: Opaque single-use correlation token for this flow.

permissions.description: Allowed UX-gating permissions for the principal.

permissions_checked.description: Stable list of permissions probed; reflects the engine's known UX gating set.

flags.description: Persona-visible feature flags. Keys are drawn from a typed enum.

titleFormat.description: Window-title format used by the sk REPL.

pushNotifyThresholdSec.description: Threshold in seconds before notify() fires.

quietHoursStart.description: Quiet-hours window start (HH:MM, local TZ). Empty disables.

quietHoursEnd.description: Quiet-hours window end (HH:MM, local TZ). Empty disables.

portalTokenTtlMin.description: TTL in minutes for portal tokens minted by /session.

prefs.description: REPL + UI preferences resolved for this principal.

server_time.description: Server-side ISO timestamp; lets the CLI sync clocks.

input.description: Persisted workflow input returned verbatim to workflow readers; credentials belong in connector credential storage.

content.description: Inline specification content or a source-specific URL/command. URL-fetched OpenAPI and Google Discovery documents are streamed with a 50 MiB limit; specification metadata seeds the connector draft.

post.summary: Redeem the first-run bootstrap token and materialise tenant + admin

Fork a conversation, copying messages up to and including the anchor
post.description: Creates a new conversation owned by the same tenant + actor and copies messages [0..anchor] in created_at order. Tool calls and elicitations are NOT copied — re-running them would duplicate side effects. Caveat: assistant message content that references `tool_call_id` values from the source will retain those refs even though the corresponding tool_call rows are not in the fork; the CLI renderer treats unknown ids as plain text, but audit-log readers should be aware. Each copied message gets a fresh `created_at` (set to fork-time) so the fork's timeline orders cleanly; the source's original timestamps are preserved in the source conversation, joinable via `forked_from` in the audit metadata. The fork is hard-capped at the most recent 5,000 messages up to and including the anchor; when the cap fires the response sets `truncated: true` and the audit row records the original source count.
